parameters.name: AgentIds
parameters.description: The list of agent IDs separated by commas (,). An agent ID is the same as the RAM user ID of the agent. A maximum of 50 agents can be specified. If this parameter is not specified, all agents are queried.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end date in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The interval type. Valid values:
- Daily: by day
- Minute5: by 5 minutes.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The page size. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: SkillGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the skill group.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start date in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. The date cannot be earlier than 6 months before the current time.
